cohort: 50,180 pregnant women with congenital uterine anomalies
finding: While the majority of pregnancies in women with congenital uterine anomalies resulted in full-term live births, uterine didelphys was associated with the highest risk of preterm birth and septate uterus with the highest risk of severe maternal morbidity.
mod_finding: The majority (65.7%) of patients with congenital uterine anomalies were delivered via cesarean section.
